caption: The drawing displays three objects arranged on a beige background. At the top is a partially colored cylindrical object with a circular loop and grooved end, colored with blue-green on the upper side and deep red on the lower side, with the rest outlined in pencil. Below, slightly to the left, is a round pendant with a gold frame and attachment, containing a dark blue-green stone speckled with red, with detailed shading to suggest the stone’s polished surface. To the right of the round pendant is another similar pendant, also with a gold frame and attachment, but featuring a deep red stone or surface. The attachment elements of this pendant are outlined but left uncolored. The drawing uses colored pencils or watercolor for the blue-green, red, and gold details, while the unfinished portions are in fine pencil outline. The composition appears technical or illustrative, with each object isolated and devoid of background context.
title: Watch Fob
